facts.fact: CIPIT's 2025 report states that Uganda's government recognised AI 'through its National 4IR Strategy launched in 2023' (verb: launched; no adopting act or body named; the strategy is cited as a Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation 2023 publication).

systems.owner: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation

note: Continental AI report; the only Uganda strategy is the 4IR Strategy, whose scope the document describes only as prioritising AI in education, financial services and service delivery, so class is left empty. It also says Uganda has no dedicated AI policy (thematic, no fact).
